messages:
maria_cs: FYI: EdgeCase submitted a model onboarding request — mobile-first shopping assistant. Wants a multilingual intent classifier + reranker, private (VPC) deployment with HSM-backed KMS, per-request PII redaction, and a strict latency SLO for mobile (99p < 300ms). They report ~250k annotated utterances across en/es/fr/pt and expect live A/B reranking + canary rollout. Need feasibility + kickoff.

sam_onboard: Thanks — assigning. Quick Q: do they need embeddings too or just reranker scores?

maria_cs: Just reranker scores + intent logits for now. No embeddings.

sam_onboard: :thumbsup: Ping @tom_eval for safety/eval plan. Also need to confirm quantization / 13B vs 7B tradeoffs for hitting 300ms 99p on mobile targets.

tom_eval: I can own evals. Plan: smoke run with ~10k samples balanced across langs, adversarial perturbations, toxicity/regulatory checks, and hallucination tests on entity-sensitive prompts.

liyuan_security: Important notes from legal: they require HSM for key management (FIPS 140-2) + data residency in eu-west-1. They also want proof of substring PII redaction and no persistent training data retention beyond 30 days.

sam_onboard: We can support HSM in Private. Need infra estimate — @deploy-bot can you open a Dedicated->Private infra ticket with expected GPU reqs? My rough calc: 13B quantized (q4) might need 2x H100 to meet 300ms 99p, or 4x A100 if non-quantized.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: CS-8421. Assignee: infra-oncall. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-8421

maria_cs: Also flagging account health risk: EdgeCase told security SLA is a renewal gating factor — if we miss latency or KMS requirements they’ll shop. Mark as "renewal risk: medium-high" and surface in next AH.

sam_onboard: I'll draft the kickoff doc and a template checklist. Need sample dataset S3 link + schema and per-language sample counts before we schedule canary. Please request from customer.

tom_eval: Suggested eval checklist for the thread so folks can copy:
```
- 10k balanced testset (en/es/fr/pt)
- 5k adversarial prompts (typos, code-switching, obfuscation)
- Toxicity filter: perspective + in-house heuristics
- PHI/PII leak tests (substring and context leakage)
- Acceptance thresholds: intent F1 >= 0.88, reranker MRR delta <= 0.02 vs baseline
```

liyuan_security: Add: confirm streaming redaction semantics — is substring redaction enforced before any tokens leave the host? They also want per-request audit logs retained for 180 days.

maria_cs: Meeting? Propose quick sync tomorrow 11:30am PT with EdgeCase CSM + infra + security. Who can join?

sam_onboard: I can. tom_eval yes. liyuan_security: maybe — 10:00–11:30 PT is tight but I can do 11:30 if necessary.

deploy-bot: Reminder: include 'onboard:edgecase' in all ticket summaries.

maria_cs: :calendar: Scheduled 11:30am PT — invite sent to team + customer. I'll upload initial dataset link in this thread once received.
